items.description: Designated WR Tyrell Shavers to return from the physically unable to perform list.
Signed TE Carsen Ryan to the practice squad.
Designated S Kerby Joseph to return from the physically unable to perform list.
Claimed DT Jonah Laulu off waivers from Las Vegas. Signed P Thomas Morstead to the practice squad. Released NT Timmy Horne.
Acquired a 2027 fourth-round draft pick from San Francisco 49ers for DT DeForest Buckner.
Signed K Justin Tucker to the practice squad. Designated DT Omarr Norman-Lott to return from the physically unable to perform list.
Signed LB Bralen Trice to the practice squad.
Signed K Joshua Karty, LS Jake McQuaide and ILB Jon Rhattigan to the practice squad. Released OL Austin Blaske, CB Nyzier Fourqurean and ILB Elias Neal from the practice squad.
Claimed G Christian Haynes off waivers from Seattle. Waived G D.J. Campbell.
Signed TEs Devin Culp and Bryson Nesbit to the practice squad. Placed WR Michael Briscoe on practice squad injured reserve.
Released WR Kyrese Rowan from the practice squad.
Signed RB Jaydon Blue from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed G Evan Beerntsen, WR Quentin Skinner and DB Shaun Wade to the practice squad. Placed RB Dameon Pierce on injured reserve.
Signed C Kingsley Eguakun from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed WR Zay Jones to the practice squad.
Acquired DT DeForest Buckner from Indianapolis for a 2027 fourth-round draft pick. Released CB Jack Jones.
Signed TE Ben Sims to the practice squad. Released TE Josiah Deguara from the practice squad.

Signed WR Van Jefferson from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed OLB Kyle Kennard to the practice squad. Placed WR Terry McLaurin on injured reserve. Designated DT Jer'Zhan Newton to return from injured reserve.
Designated RB Adam Randall to return from injured reserve.
Claimed RB Emari Demercado off waivers from Dallas. Placed WR Jaylin Noel on injured reserve.
Signed OLB Andre Jones Jr. and CB A.J. Woods to the practice squad. Released CB Anthony Kendall and DL Austin Johnson from the practice squad.
Signed RB Zavier Scott from the practice squad to the active roster. Released DB Nick McCloud.

Signed TE Cam Grandy from Minnesota's practice squad to the active roster. Signed TE Caden Prieskorn to the practice squad. Placed TE Erick All Jr. on injured reserve and TE Josh Kattus on practice squad injured reserve.
Signed DE Nadame Tucker to the practice squad. Released RB Jaret Patterson and S John Saunders from the practice squad.
Waived RB Emari Demercado and TE D.J. Rogers.
Signed WR Eli Pancol to the practice squad. Released DB Ugochukwu Amadi from the practice squad.
Signed DT Taki Taimani to the practice squad. Released WR Lawrence Keys from the practice squad.
